meta.subtitulo: Exploratory model output from the Period Components export. This is not field validation or a record of observed crop cycles.
meta.synthetic_inputs_notice: SYNTHETIC INPUTS USED HERE — The raw channel units and physical locations are undocumented. Light groups and their open/between/under labels are unverified scenario assumptions; PAR uses an assumed 0.45 fraction. The plotted canopy-temperature curve is a seasonal sinusoid; crop-cycle growth uses supplemental TMY air temperatures, not measured temperatures from the irradiance year. Wind and humidity are not measured or modeled in this viewer. Unrecorded irradiance timestamps are assumed to have zero light. Crop biomass values are uncalibrated model-derived scenario estimates, not validated yields: the growth equation, channel units, and dry-matter conversion are not calibrated for this site. GDD-based timing lets cooler, longer cycles accumulate more modeled mass. The per-plant conversion assumes the configured 96 plants on 11.25 m²; the user-reported 100–300 g/plant range is a plausibility reference only, not a calibration dataset. Do not interpret this visualization as independent validation or field evidence. Generated from commit 5163dd17f87050be3e514c6e9b9ed8d972a8e9b0; working tree dirty: true. Crop-cycle and harvest markers are generated as model scenarios using the supplemental typical-year temperature series, not measured site air temperature from the irradiance year or observed harvests; they are not calibrated or observed harvest predictions. A cycle still in progress at the end of the data is not a completed harvest.
